articles.title: Bhubaneswar-Dubai direct flights: Odisha govt invites bids to resume service
articles.description: The Odisha government has invited bids from airline operators to resume direct flights between Bhubaneswar and Dubai. The service was suspended in March amid tensions in West Asia. According to the tender, the selected airline will operate an aircraft with at least 180 seats under a state supported subsidy scheme, as reported by The Times of India. Minimum Three Flights A Week The airline will have to meet all regulatory, operational, commercial and safety requirements for the route. The tender also requires at least three flights a week. The operator must to adhere the regulations set by the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA), Bureau of Civil Aviation Security (BCAS), Airports Authority of India (AAI) and other relevant authorities. Flight Service Started In 2023 The direct Bhubaneswar-Dubai service had began on May 15, 2023. The flight were conducted three times a week on Monday, Wednesday and Friday before it was suspended. The resumption of the service is expected to help passengers travelling between Odisha and Dubai for business, tourism and other purposes. Similarly, direct flight services between Bhubaneswar and Bangkok resumed on October 2 after the international route remained temporarily suspended since July. The resumption of the route is expected to provide another international travel option for passengers from Bhubaneswar and surrounding areas.

articles.title: Odisha to get space research push: New Atmospheric Science Centre planned in Balasore
articles.description: India is planning to establish a dedicated Atmospheric and Space Science Research Facility (ASRF) at Chandipur in Odisha’s Balasore district. The Department of Space has invited tenders for the proposed centre, which will support research into atmospheric processes, weather and the space environment. According to India Today, the facility is being developed jointly by the Department of Space, the Ministry of Earth Sciences and the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO). The project builds on the Balasore Rocket Launching Station, which has been operational since 1979. The station is used to launch sounding rockets equipped with scientific instruments to collect data from the upper atmosphere. What Will The Research Centre Do? The ASRF is envisioned as a major research site where scientists can study atmospheric and space-related phenomena. The research is expected to improve understanding of conditions surrounding Earth, including atmospheric processes and factors that influence radio signal transmission. The facility has been described as a research “super site” involving multiple government agencies. In a December 2024 reply in the Rajya Sabha, Minister of State for Science and Technology Jitendra Singh confirmed the joint participation of the three departments. Project Cost And Tender Details The construction project is estimated to cost Rs 9.06 crore. This includes Rs 5.67 crore for civil and plumbing work, Rs 2.97 crore for electrical installations and Rs 42 lakh for air-conditioning. Construction is expected to take 15 months from the issuance of the work order. Indian contractors can download the tender documents between October 23 and November 12, 2026, with bids due by November 20 and technical bids scheduled to open on November 23. The tender requires an earnest money deposit of Rs 18.12 lakh, although micro and small enterprises are exempt from the requirement.

articles.title: Rs 28 per copy under BJP vs Rs 55 under AAP: Delhi Education Minister challenges AAP over textbook procurement allegations
articles.description: Delhi Education Minister Ashish Sood has rejected AAP allegations of irregularities in school textbook procurement, claiming the BJP government purchased books at Rs 28 per copy compared with Rs 55 under the previous government. Challenging claims that the new books were smaller, Sood asked reporters to compare the editions and questioned the alleged price difference as a political row over textbook printing and tendering intensified.

articles.title: Nishikant Dubey alleges ‘sinister plot’ to destabilise India, raises questions over foreign links of Rahul Gandhi
articles.description: Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) MP Nishikant Dubey on October 22, said that opposition-led protests in India were part of a conspiracy to destabilise the country. Addressing a press conference here, Dubey questioned Lok Sabha Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi’s alleged links with US lawmakers Ilhan Omar and Ro Khanna, and raised concerns over foreign funding, cryptocurrency and online gambling. Dubey claimed that foreign organisations and individuals were attempting to fuel protests to bring about a change of government in India. He alleged that the Congress leadership was working with foreign elements, although he did not present independently verified evidence to substantiate the claims. “All these people – whoever is in the leadership of the Congress party, whoever the opposition is – are all working together with foreign powers to not change the regime, but to break the country,” Dubey said. Questioning Rahul Gandhi’s overseas engagements, the BJP MP alleged that the Congress leader had met individuals who, according to him, were working against India’s interests. “I said in Parliament that under the guise of the Soros Foundation, he meets Ilhan Omar and Ro Khanna,” Dubey said, referring to the US lawmakers. “My question to Congress is – Regarding Neville Roy Singham, the cartels involved in online gambling, artificial intelligence, and cryptocurrency with which individuals from these circles has Rahul Gandhi met over the past five years? Which of these individuals have participated in his ‘Bharat Jodo Yatra’ or other such journeys? Moreover, whenever he travels abroad, with which of these elements does he meet, and what kind of plans do they devise to destabilise the country?” he added. He also questioned whether Sam Pitroda had a role in what he described as alleged conspiracies to destabilise India, and asked whom Gandhi had met during his foreign visits and who had been associated with his Bharat Jodo Yatra. Dubey further referred to US congressional documents that he claimed discussed foreign influence, protests and technology-related concerns. He linked the issue to cryptocurrency, artificial intelligence and online gambling, alleging that these areas could be exploited by foreign actors to influence political movements. “The future ahead is of artificial intelligence, to destroy the entire world’s economy there is cryptocurrency, and the third is online gambling,” he said, arguing that these issues required greater scrutiny. The BJP MP also defended the government’s approach to regulating online gambling and cryptocurrency, saying online gambling had been banned and cryptocurrency did not have legal tender status in India. He said the government had taken steps to address concerns surrounding these activities. Dubey also targeted the ongoing protests in Delhi, criticising demonstrations at Jantar Mantar and alleging that protesters were disrupting public life. His remarks came after Delhi Police summoned Cockroach Janata Party leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka following their release from judicial custody by a Special Executive Magistrate court, subject to undertakings to maintain peace and comply with the law. The two leaders were detained in connection with an October 13 protest at Jantar Mantar, which had been denotified as a designated protest site. The court ordered their release after accepting personal and surety bonds and written undertakings. Also Read: New Keralam Governor Om Prakash Mathur sworn in amid Congress criticism Dubey also raised concerns over demographic changes in Jharkhand’s Santhal Pargana region, alleging that illegal immigration from Bangladesh had contributed to changes in population patterns. He said opposition to the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls was politically motivated. The BJP MP maintained that elections, rather than protests, were the appropriate means of changing a government, saying his party would take its arguments to the public. (with inputs from ANI)

articles.title: The Tender247 Story: Turning tender intelligence into a competitive advantage with Anupam Kher
articles.description: Harnessing the power of AI, Tender247 is transforming the landscape for businesses seeking tender opportunities on government platforms. Appointing Anupam Kher as its brand ambassador, the company focuses on simplifying the tender process for smaller businesses. The initiative promises to enhance decision-making capabilities and facilitate greater access to public procurement contracts, resulting in a more inclusive bidding environment.

articles.title: TheTenders Offers Comprehensive Tender Bidding Support and GeM Portal Services to Help Businesses Access Government Opportunities
articles.description: New Delhi [India], October 23: The Government e-Marketplace (GeM) is an online public procurement platform that enables eligible sellers, manufacturers, contractors, and service providers to offer goods and services to government departments and other authorised buyers. Businesses can explore GeM Tenders in India and participate in procurement opportunities according to the applicable eligibility criteria, tender conditions, and platform policies.
